archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Serious Sam: Shatterverse Announced

entries.headline: Serious Sam: Shatterverse Announced as an FPS Roguelike Take on the Classic Series

mediaAlts.alt: Serious Sam: Shatterverse promotional image accompanying the announcement of its FPS roguelike direction.

entries.summary: Behaviour Interactive detailed Serious Sam: Shatterverse on Xbox Wire. The new game reworks the Serious Sam formula as an FPS roguelike with peer-to-peer multiplayer and an offline solo mode. The team says it is being built as a complete standalone release while leaving room for expansions, DLC, and additional content.
entries.timeNote: Xbox Wire lists the article at 2026-08-31T18:00:00Z, which is 02:00 Beijing time on September 1 and falls within this edition's fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire developer article directly supports the game's positioning, core design direction, and multiplayer and solo approach.

entries.headline: State of Play and State of Play Japan Set for Back-to-Back Broadcasts on September 3

mediaAlts.alt: PlayStation image for the September 3 State of Play and State of Play Japan broadcasts.

entries.summary: PlayStation announced two consecutive broadcasts for September 3. State of Play will feature updates from PlayStation Studios and third-party partners and close with an extended look at Final Fantasy VII Revelation. State of Play Japan, hosted by Yuki Kaji, will then focus on new games, gameplay, and announcements from Japanese and Asian studios. The broadcasts begin at 21:00 Beijing time on YouTube and Twitch.
entries.timeNote: PlayStation Blog lists the announcement at 2026-08-31T05:00:10-07:00, or 20:00 Beijing time on August 31. The stated 10:00 p.m. JST broadcast start converts to 21:00 Beijing time on September 3.
entries.verification: The opened PlayStation Blog announcement directly supports the date, back-to-back format, program scope, host, featured title, and broadcast platforms and time.

entries.headline: 007 First Light Switch 2 Physical Edition Delayed Again

mediaAlts.alt: 007 First Light image accompanying the report on the delayed Nintendo Switch 2 physical edition.

entries.summary: H2 INTERACTIVE announced that the Nintendo Switch 2 physical edition of 007 First Light will no longer launch in the previously stated latter half of summer 2026. A new release date will be announced later. AUTOMATON also notes that the PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S versions have already been released.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 2026-08-31T04:49:47Z, or 12:49 Beijing time on August 31, within this edition's fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report directly relays and embeds H2 INTERACTIVE's notice about the Switch 2 physical-edition delay. Because the primary notice was not opened separately, the Canonical status remains a media relay of an official announcement.

entries.headline: Stranded Deep 2 Formally Announced, Steam Early Access Planned for Early 2027

mediaAlts.alt: Stranded Deep 2 image accompanying its formal announcement and Early Access plans.

entries.summary: North Beach Games formally announced the open-world survival game Stranded Deep 2. The sequel moves from the first game's island setting to a river running through a desert region. It is planned to enter Early Access on PC via Steam in early 2027, with the Early Access period expected to last two to three years.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 2026-09-01T01:03:19Z, or 09:03 Beijing time on September 1, before the 10:10 cutoff.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report supports the formal announcement, Steam platform, early-2027 Early Access plan, expected two-to-three-year Early Access period, and the shift to a desert-and-river setting.

entries.headline: Former Fate/EXTRA Record Director Kazuya Niinou Leaves TYPE-MOON studio BB and the Project

mediaAlts.alt: Fate/EXTRA Record image accompanying the report on Kazuya Niinou leaving TYPE-MOON studio BB and the project.

entries.summary: Kazuya Niinou announced that he has left TYPE-MOON studio BB, stepped down as director of Fate/EXTRA Record, and withdrawn from the development team. He also said he will temporarily step away from game development. The personnel change was disclosed after the project's move to Aniplex as publisher.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 2026-08-31T03:10:09Z, or 11:10 Beijing time on August 31. That is after the previous edition's 10:10 cutoff and inside this edition's window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report directly quotes Niinou's public statement. His original social-media post was not opened separately, so the Canonical status remains a media relay of the person's own statement.

entries.headline: Live TV on PS5 Launches in the U.S. with More Than 100 Free Ad-Supported Channels

mediaAlts.alt: Live TV on PS5 image accompanying the U.S. launch announcement.

entries.summary: Sony Interactive Entertainment launched Live TV on PS5, a free ad-supported live and on-demand service provided by Sony Pictures Television. U.S. PS5 users can access it from the console's Media section. The launch lineup includes more than 100 channels spanning news, sports, movies, television, anime, and other programming.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu published the report at 2026-08-31T16:10:05Z, or 00:10 Beijing time on September 1, within this edition's fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report explicitly relays Sony Interactive Entertainment's launch announcement and supports the U.S. availability, PS5 access path, free ad-supported model, and more-than-100-channel launch lineup.

entries.headline: Pikmin 3 Deluxe Gets a Free Switch 2 Update with Visual Upgrades and GameShare

mediaAlts.alt: Pikmin 3 Deluxe image accompanying the free Switch 2 update with visual improvements and GameShare.

entries.summary: Nintendo released a free update for Pikmin 3 Deluxe. When played on Switch 2, the game receives visual improvements for the console screen and high-resolution televisions, and the update adds GameShare support so two players can play Bingo Battle locally or through GameChat.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu published the report at 2026-09-01T01:53:42Z, or 09:53 Beijing time on September 1, before the 10:10 cutoff.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report explicitly relays Nintendo's release of the free update and supports the Switch 2 visual enhancements and GameShare functionality. Nintendo's primary page was not opened separately, so the Canonical status remains a media relay of an official update.

entries.headline: IGN Awards Onimusha: Way of the Sword a 10
entries.summary: Following the review embargo, 3DM reported that IGN awarded Onimusha: Way of the Sword a perfect 10, highlighting its narrative and combat. This item confirms only the reported score and does not extend the relayed appraisal into additional factual claims.
entries.verification: The opened 3DM report explicitly states that the review embargo had lifted and that IGN awarded the game a 10. Because IGN's original review was not opened in the accepted evidence, the Canonical classification remains a media report.
entries.timeNote: The 3DM page shows a publication time of 2026-09-01 06:12:27 Beijing time, parsed in the accepted evidence as 2026-08-31T22:12:27.000Z, within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: The Blood of Dawnwalker Opens at 84 on PC and 83 on PS5 on Metacritic
entries.summary: 3DM reported that reviews for The Blood of Dawnwalker are now live, with Metacritic averages of 84 for the PC version and 83 for the PS5 version. The report also lists scores of 80 from both Eurogamer and VGC. This item uses only the aggregate and outlet scores explicitly listed on that page.
entries.verification: The opened 3DM report explicitly lists the Metacritic PC score of 84, PS5 score of 83, and scores of 80 from Eurogamer and VGC. Because neither Metacritic nor the original reviews were opened in the accepted evidence, the Canonical classification remains a media report.
entries.timeNote: The 3DM page shows a publication time of 2026-09-01 09:18:59 Beijing time, parsed in the accepted evidence as 2026-09-01T01:18:59.000Z, within this edition's fixed window.
